en.bdb: The conduct of the liberated one

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੀ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੋਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: gur sikhee gursikh sun a(n)dhar siaanaa baahar bholaa|

en.bdb: Listening to the teachings of the Guru, the Sikh becomes wise internally though apparently he looks a simpleton.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਸੁਣਈ ਬੋਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat saavadhaan hoi vin gur sabadh na suniee bolaa|

en.bdb: He with full care keeps his  consciousness attuned to the Word and listens to nothing except the words  of Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾ ਖੋਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: satigur dharasan dhekhanaa saadhasa(n)gat vin a(n)nhaa kholaa|

en.bdb: He beholds the true Guru and without the company of the saints  feels himself blind and deaf.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਲੈ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਚੁਪਿ ਚਬੋਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: vaahaguroo gur sabadh lai piram piaalaa chup chabolaa|

en.bdb: The Guru's word he receives is Vahiguru, the  wondrous Lord, and remains silently immersed in delight.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਚਰਣਿ ਧੋਇ ਚਰਣੋਦਕ ਝੋਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: pairee pai paa khaak hoi charan dhoi charanodhak jholaa|

en.bdb: He bows on the  feet and becoming (humble) like dust goes on quaffing the nectar of the feet  (of the Lord).

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਭਵਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਵਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰੋਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: charan kaval chit bhavar kar bhavajal a(n)dhar rahai nirolaa|

en.bdb: He remains involved like black bee in the lotus feet (of the  Guru) and thus living in this world ocean remains unsmeared (by its water  and dust).
His is life of a liberated one during the life on earth i.e. he is a  jivanmukt'.
